audience.text: Python developers building document processing applications who need to parse, edit, and convert DOCX, DOC, RTF, Markdown, and plain-text files without external dependencies or licensing costs.

capabilities.text: Reads DOCX, DOC (Word 97-2003), RTF, Markdown, and plain-text files into a shared Light Document Model using dedicated readers for each format.
capabilities.title: Read multiple document formats

capabilities.text: Exports documents to DOCX, Markdown, PDF, and plain text using dedicated writers (LdmDocxWriter, LdmMarkdownWriter, LdmPdfWriter) with configurable options.
capabilities.title: Export to multiple output formats

capabilities.text: Handles inline images, captioned images, images in tables, and images in headers/footers, embedding them as base64 data URIs in Markdown and rendering them in PDF output.
capabilities.title: Image handling across formats

capabilities.text: Exposes the parsed Light Document Model through Document.light_document_model, allowing direct inspection of sections, paragraphs, runs, tables, styles, and lists as typed Pydantic models.
capabilities.title: Document model inspection

capabilities.text: Supports configurable export through MarkdownSaveOptions, PdfSaveOptions, and OoxmlSaveOptions for fine-grained control over output formatting and packaging.
capabilities.title: Configurable export options

capabilities.text: Implements DOCX reading using standard library zipfile and xml.etree modules, with no compiled dependencies or external engine requirements.
capabilities.title: Pure-Python implementation

limitations.text: SaveFormat.DOC is defined for API compatibility but Document.save() does not implement a DOC writer; saving to DOC raises ValueError.
OoxmlSaveOptions.compliance set to ISO29500_2008_STRICT is not implemented; the writer raises NotImplementedError.

Eight PdfSaveOptions fields (text_compression, embed_full_fonts, use_core_fonts, font_embedding_mode, page_mode, color_mode, preserve_form_fields, memory_optimization) exist for API forward-compatibility but are not consumed by the PDF writer.

problems_solved.text: Enables pure-Python document processing by reading DOCX, DOC, RTF, Markdown, and plain-text files into a shared Light Document Model without requiring Microsoft Word or COM automation.
Supports round-trip editing of DOCX files while preserving headers, footers, inline shapes, images, bookmarks, and custom paragraph styles through dedicated readers and writers.
Provides built-in rendering for PDF and Markdown export using only pure-Python dependencies (fpdf2 and standard library modules), eliminating external engine or system font requirements.
Enables conversion of image-containing documents across all supported formats, embedding images as base64 data URIs in Markdown and rendering them in PDF output.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Words FOSS for Python is a free, open-source Python library for reading and writing Word documents without Microsoft Word or COM automation.

workflows.name: Load and convert documents
workflows.text: Construct a Document from a file path or stream, then call save() with a SaveFormat constant or save options to export to DOCX, Markdown, PDF, or plain text.

workflows.name: Parse Markdown with rich structure
workflows.text: Use MarkdownLoadOptions to load Markdown content from bytes or streams, preserving headings, lists, emphasis, tables, block quotes, code blocks, links, and embedded images as typed document nodes.

workflows.name: Inspect and manipulate the document model
workflows.text: Access the parsed Light Document Model through Document.light_document_model to inspect sections, paragraphs, runs, tables, styles, and lists as typed Pydantic models.

workflows.name: Export to PDF with configurable options
workflows.text: Use LdmPdfWriter with PdfSaveOptions to render documents to PDF using a built-in paragraph, table, and shape renderer backed by fpdf2.

workflows.name: Export to Markdown with formatting control
workflows.text: Use LdmMarkdownWriter with MarkdownSaveOptions to control heading style, list markers, code block style, table alignment, link export mode, and image embedding.

workflows.name: Round-trip DOCX editing
workflows.text: Load a DOCX file using DocumentReader, modify the Light Document Model, and write it back using LdmDocxWriter with OoxmlSaveOptions to preserve formatting and structure.
